Current language: EN EN DE IT Submit search Coming to unibz from abroad With more than 30 study programmes and some of the highest number of international students and lecturers in Italy, unibz is the right place if you are looking for a small international university tailor-made for your needs. International Applicants The Free University of Bozen-Bolzano is a trilingual University located in one of the most fascinating European regions, at the crossroads between the German-speaking and Italian economies and cultures. It has five faculties, and has a high percentage of lecturers (35%) and students (17%) who come from abroad to study, teach and do research in the fields of Economics, Business, Communication, Natural Sciences, Engineering, Social Sciences, Education, Design and Art. Applicants from Abroad International degree-seeking applicants Everything you need to know to start your studies at unibz International PhD applicants Application procedure, visa, residence permit and more Incoming exchange students Erasmus+ Mobility for Studies, Erasmus+ Mobility for Traineeship, Bilateral Agreements, and Free Mover Studying in South Tyrol Living in a place where people go on holiday: isn't it the dream of many? When our students from over 40 countries are not busy with reading and classes, they can enjoy the privilege of living in one of the most attractive touristic regions in Europe. In South Tyrol the cultural choice is ample and exciting and, for those who like sports - not only winter sports - the region is a paradise on earth, with modern and well-equipped facilities. At the background of this study experience, you have the spectacular view of the Dolomites, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Course Catalogue Academic Calendar 2026/27 Specific info - Faculty of Economics and Management International Relations office We are your first contact point at unibz. Our staff can provide you with information about suitable housing, medical assistance during your stay in Italy, enrolment procedure and residence permit in Italy. At the end of your stay, we will send the transcript of records to your home university. Exchange Student Bolzano Our Exchange Student Bolzano team is pleased to assist you in settling in and invite you to cultural and recreational events or excursions in the surroundings. Do not hesitate to get in touch with them here . Studying and living in South Tyrol Student life is a time for meeting new people, taking up new hobbies (or continuing with existing ones!) and taking a break from your studies. There are plenty of opportunities in Bozen-Bolzano to pursue whatever hobby or interest you may have. Current language: EN EN DE IT Submit search International degree-seeking Applicants International students At the four campuses of Bozen-Bolzano City Centre, Bozen-Bolzano NOI Techpark (situated in the innovation district of the technological park), Brixen-Bressanone and Bruneck-Brunico, students can rely on excellent services and individual tutoring. Our classes, taught by lecturers of more than 40 different nationalities, are held in small groups. This helps lecturers get to know students and monitor their progress better. Our University has established international exchange programmes with more than 200 universities in Spain, USA, Taiwan and many other countries. Highlights Apply now Applications are now open! Lessons and exams are in Italian, German and English. At the end of their degrees, graduates also receive a ‘Language Diploma Supplement’, a document that certifies the language levels achieved. In order to be admitted to most of our study programmes, we require a B2 level certification of competence in at least two of the three official languages. Some master programmes are taught only in English, though. More info Accommodation and Food The student halls at the Bozen-Bolzano and Brixen-Bressanone campuses host 700 students. The price for a single bedroom is €360 and €270 for a double room. You can usually apply online for an accommodation from mid-June until the beginning of July. You can find adverts to rent a room in a flat-share on: accommodationunibz.blogspot.it yost.apartments Facebook group There is a canteen where students can choose their favourite food from a rich menu and pay with their Student Card. Transport Students under 26 can buy the südtirolmobil U26 Pass valid for a year for €150. This ticket is managed by the local government (Autonomous Province of Bozen-Bolzano). It can be used on all public transport in South Tyrol and on regional trains to Trento. Bozen-Bolzano, Brixen-Bressanone and Bruneck-Brunico - like all South Tyrol - are small towns and, therefore, very suitable for cycling. Classrooms are easy to reach by bike in less than 15 minutes from each student hall! Living costs in South Tyrol Living costs in South Tyrol are comparable to those of many other cities in Northern Italy. Approximately, if you exclude tuition fees, you will need at least €800 per month for living (accommodation, food, study materials, leisure, clothing) in the Bozen-Bolzano area. Student Associations Studying is fundamental, but you also have to socialise with other members of the student community. At unibz we have five student associations: SCUB, kikero, Exchange Students unibz, AlumniClub and, on the Brixen-Bressanone campus, Talìa UniLife. The most popular event of the year is the SnowDays, organised by SCUB, which normally attracts more than 600 students, many of whom are registered at partner universities and arrive to South Tyrol for the first time just to attend the event. More info Bachelor Days and Online Info Sessions unibz opens its doors to proepsctive students so that, before applying, they can learn more about the study programmes that interest them. During the Bachelor Days , students will be able to visit not only the university and its facilities but also the student halls of residence. Moreover, we organise Master Online Info Sessions . During the Online Info Sessions, you can attend the presentations of each master programme and ask questions to lecturers and students who have chosen unibz for their studies. More info Studying barrier free Students with disabilities who are planning to study at unibz can contact the Student Support to clarify any doubts they may have and ask for information relating to their needs (accessibility of buildings, applications for support, etc.). Upon request of students with disabilities, the University can arrange for admission procedures to be customised to meet the needs of each student also by making available any specific technological devices and learning equipment required. More info Advisory Service Our Advisory Service is the main point of contact for students to find out information. Students can also request an individual guidance appointment about our degree courses and life as a student at unibz. More info Information and guidance for secondary school students During the entire academic year, our guidance service office offers students in the last year of secondary education the opportunity to get to know our university directly through guidance and information events. Some master programmes are taught only in English, though. More info Accommodation and Food The student halls at the Bozen-Bolzano and Brixen-Bressanone campuses host 700 students. The price for a single bedroom is €360 and €270 for a double room. You can usually apply online for an accommodation from mid-June until the beginning of July. You can find adverts to rent a room in a flat-share on: accommodationunibz.blogspot.it yost.apartments Facebook group There is a canteen where students can choose their favourite food from a rich menu and pay with their Student Card. Transport Students under 26 can buy the südtirolmobil U26 Pass valid for a year for €150. This ticket is managed by the local government (Autonomous Province of Bozen-Bolzano). It can be used on all public transport in South Tyrol and on regional trains to Trento. Bozen-Bolzano, Brixen-Bressanone and Bruneck-Brunico - like all South Tyrol - are small towns and, therefore, very suitable for cycling. Classrooms are easy to reach by bike in less than 15 minutes from each student hall! Living costs in South Tyrol Living costs in South Tyrol are comparable to those of many other cities in Northern Italy. Approximately, if you exclude tuition fees, you will need at least €800 per month for living (accommodation, food, study materials, leisure, clothing) in the Bozen-Bolzano area. Student Associations Studying is fundamental, but you also have to socialise with other members of the student community. At unibz we have five student associations: SCUB, kikero, Exchange Students unibz, AlumniClub and, on the Brixen-Bressanone campus, Talìa UniLife. The most popular event of the year is the SnowDays, organised by SCUB, which normally attracts more than 600 students, many of whom are registered at partner universities and arrive to South Tyrol for the first time just to attend the event. More info Bachelor Days and Online Info Sessions unibz opens its doors to proepsctive students so that, before applying, they can learn more about the study programmes that interest them. During the Bachelor Days , students will be able to visit not only the university and its facilities but also the student halls of residence. Moreover, we organise Master Online Info Sessions . During the Online Info Sessions, you can attend the presentations of each master programme and ask questions to lecturers and students who have chosen unibz for their studies. More info Studying barrier free Students with disabilities who are planning to study at unibz can contact the Student Support to clarify any doubts they may have and ask for information relating to their needs (accessibility of buildings, applications for support, etc.). Upon request of students with disabilities, the University can arrange for admission procedures to be customised to meet the needs of each student also by making available any specific technological devices and learning equipment required. More info Advisory Service Our Advisory Service is the main point of contact for students to find out information. Students can also request an individual guidance appointment about our degree courses and life as a student at unibz. Current language: EN EN DE IT Submit search Training for companies and forms of partnership description The exchange of knowledge between unibz and companies and the implementation of joint projects are of fundamental importance for the competitiveness of companies, the employability of graduates and the economic and social growth of South Tyrol. Dual study programmes enable companies to retain specialists at an early stage and maintain close contact with unibz. During the training, students acquire company-specific product and process knowledge as well as professional skills. Training and refresher courses for employees also represent a form of collaboration between university and companies. dual study programme Training for companies and forms of partnership The exchange of knowledge between unibz and companies and the implementation of joint projects are of fundamental importance for the competitiveness of companies, the employability of graduates and the economic and social growth of South Tyrol. Dual study programmes enable companies to retain specialists at an early stage and maintain close contact with unibz. During the training, students acquire company-specific product and process knowledge as well as professional skills. Dual study programme; Bachelor in Industrial and Mechanical Engineering The nationwide unique dual study programme is offered in collaboration with Assoimprenditori Alto Adige, the association of local entrepreneurs. Students can combine studies and work. In this case the duration of the programme is extended to four years. The first year is designed as full-time study, while from the second year study and professional activity alternate. Students can receive a scholarship in the first year, at the end of the first year the employment contract is signed with a company involved in this programme. Are you a company and would you like to work with unibz on a dual study programme? Companies that are interested in accepting dual students can express their interest by filling out a company profile (please fill in the form and send it to the Career Service: careerservice@unibz.it ). The profiles are forwarded to students.
